decisionsTitle: The build stamp shows only in the open fold — on the desktop too
decisionsSection:
The owner, 2026-10-01, from his phone, with a screenshot of the desktop bar: «vreau ca pill-ul cu versiunea sa apara doar cand fac expand la footer. e un pic deranjant pt vizitatori».

§365 (2026-09-24, «version shows by default») had put the stamp inside the «Despre club, contact și termeni» fold, on screen at no width until somebody opened it. §372 added the same day a second copy pinned to the bar's bottom-right corner from `md`, the owner's «I liked when I saw the app on the bottom right». Seen from a visitor's side that corner copy is noise on every page: the stamp exists for staff and for whoever asks «which site am I on», and both can open the fold. So §372's pinned copy is superseded and §365's rule returns at every width.

**The decision.** One `BuildBadge` render per page, the last line of the fold's panel, at every width and in every environment; on screen only once the fold is open. The chip, its words, the 44-pixel box and the staff entrance (§34: double-click, long press or Enter; a single click or tap does nothing) are unchanged; nothing else on the bar moves. The pinned `footer-build-badge-pinned` box is deleted and the fold's copy loses its `md: none`; the test id `footer-build-badge-panel` stays. With one copy left, `BuildBadge` loses its `phoneTarget` prop: the fold's box (24-px line plus 20-px reach on a phone, 44 from `sm`) is its only shape.

**What stays measured.** The phone panel's heights of §480 (the stamp's 24-px line with its 20-px reach above) do not change; the bar's row is untouched.

**Tests.** `site-footer.test.ts`: the stamp is rendered once, inside `<details>` after its `<summary>`, `app-ver` once, and `footer-build-badge-pinned` nowhere in the markup; the chip assertions iterate the panel only. `build-badge.spec.ts`: the «not on screen until the fold is opened» test runs on both projects; one desktop test covers hidden-when-closed, single click does nothing, double-click and Enter open sign-in; the chip test covers click and double-click on both projects, so the mobile single-tap and double-click/Enter tests, now repeats, are gone, and the phone's long-press test stays with its true skip reason. `footer.spec.ts`: the closed bar shows no stamp at any width, and a 1280-px test checks it hidden, then visible inside the footer and not wider than the screen once the fold opens. Playwright was not run in this round, by the owner's rule that E2E stays in CI.

*Rejected:* hiding the pinned chip with opacity or on hover (still a layout item and still read by assistive technology, and a hover is not a thumb); keeping the pin only above some wider breakpoint (the owner's screenshot is a wide desktop); showing the stamp only to signed-in staff (the stamp is the door to signing in).
changelogLine: - **The version stamp hides until the footer opens** — the desktop corner no longer shows «app-ver» on every page; open «Despre club, contact și termeni» to read it, at every width. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 28, 41 and 60. Given any public page at any width and in any environment, when the footer renders with its fold closed, then no build stamp is on screen and none is pinned to the bar: the stamp is rendered once, as the last line of the «Despre club» fold's panel. With the fold open it sits inside the footer and is never wider than the screen, and it is still the staff entrance — a double-click, a long press or Enter opens sign-in, and a single tap or click does nothing (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the version stamp shows only in the open fold, on the desktop too
